purpose: Produce a clean operator/agent handoff after bootstrap, readiness, or bounded sprint work.
requiredFields: optional CMD compatibility-shim state and last exit when attempted
commit/push/PR state when work was launched
one exact next executable command or action
rules: Never hand off a post-setup readiness command when bootstrap state has not been observed.
If fleet state or the installed PowerShell operator implementation is absent, the next action is repository-owned bootstrap/repair, not -ListAgents.
If the CMD shim is missing or returned Access is denied / exit 5 while the PowerShell implementation exists, report cmd-shim-blocked and use prove-readiness-through-powershell; do not retry the shim.
If fleet is installed but readiness is not current, the next action is PowerShell -ListAgents/readiness, not sprint launch.
If an adapter is blocked, report its recorded evidence and repair command rather than switching agents silently.
If provider verification is outstanding, name that exact gate without claiming hosted response.
If the target repository is dirty, preserve the dirty work and name the isolation/cleanup owner before launching GNHF.
Local runtime artifacts remain untracked unless deliberately minimized and reviewed.
proofCeiling: Handoff completeness only; it cannot promote bootstrap, provider, sprint, merge, or deployment proof.
